v5.9.29 - Cold start navigation fix
Fixes --- - Cold start uses explicit home → character → scenario phases so scenario pick runs after trainee selection - Scenario picker detected with a single OCR keyword (no longer requires two) - Confirm/Next after character pick advances to scenario phase reliably - Settings migration backfills cold start and related parent-farming toggles on older profiles
Includes v5.9.28 settings persistence fix and prior hotfixes.
